findings.detail: Copied repaired source without reference objects, ancestry, ledgers or refit contracts could evade the new execution fallback because its fingerprint depended on reading bb69 from the candidate repository. Campaign history recognition also omitted the R3 family from local and REST tree checks.
findings.requiredCorrection: Pin the canonical masked-src digest in installed authority; use it for execution and local/REST history recognition; add copied-source regressions with no reference objects or alternates.
